Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Rolled back `payments-worker`** from the unhealthy **v3.4.0** (deployed this morning, 18% error rate) to the last healthy production release **v3.3.0** — rolled out across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

2. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) for the payments-worker errors, which paged the on-call engineer. Summary: v3.4.0 was unhealthy in production with 18% error rate across all regions, causing downstream payments API errors; rolled back to v3.3.0.

## Verification

Post-rollback status confirms the service is now **healthy** on **v3.3.0** with error rate down to **0.2%** (from 18%).

Note: the rollback to v3.3.0 is a previously-healthy-in-production version, so no change-manager approval was required. The incident remains open for the on-call engineer to investigate the root cause of the v3.4.0 regression.
